purpose: Answer Lane B request for minimal general-purpose core/type primitives that every lowering must preserve.

computational: unbounded iteration/recursion or an equivalent universal control mechanism
state cells or an equivalent state-passing/linear mechanism
memory_and_concurrency_required_for_syst: raw pointer/address operations expressible in unsafe/foreign profile
atomics and memory-order semantics as typed operations
semantic_types: intent semantic hash and contract/provenance identity
minimal_core_contract.critical_separation: Lowering may change bytes, ABI handles, process location and backend representation but must not infer/widen capability authority from serializable model-visible fields.

application_acceptance: At least CLI, HTTP, GUI, game, database, compiler/JIT, GPU/ML, embedded/robotics, admin, disk formatter and kernel/driver class must remain expressible under appropriate profiles/capabilities.
